children: The Brazilian government will continue taking measures consistent with its proposed primary fiscal targets to slow the growth of mandatory spending, Planning and Budget Minister Bruno Moretti said on Friday.

Moretti also said in an interview with SBT News that it is important to dispel the notion that fiscal adjustment can be achieved solely through revenue, a strategy often linked with the current administration's fiscal efforts.
